Plantable Seed Pencil (12pc Set) – Eco-Friendly Stationery for Sustainable Gifting

The Plantable Seed Pencil (12pc set) is an innovative and eco-friendly stationery option designed for conscious consumers, businesses, students, and gifting needs. Made using 100% recycled paper and premium 2B graphite rods, these sustainable pencils help reduce plastic waste while supporting a greener environment. Each box contains 12 pencils featuring assorted seed varieties, allowing the user to plant the stub after use and grow real herbs, flowers, or vegetables. Packed neatly in durable recycled paper tube packaging with instructions included, this set delivers both practicality and environmental responsibility.

This zero-waste concept makes the Plantable Seed Pencil (12pc set) a top choice for eco-friendly corporate gifting, school supplies, return gifts, workshop kits, NGO campaigns, and sustainable lifestyle stores. With rising demand for biodegradable stationery and conscious products, these pencils are crafted to meet modern sustainability standards without compromising writing quality or durability. The 2B graphite rods ensure smooth, dark writing suitable for everyday use in offices, classrooms, creative workspaces, and professional environments.

Each is handcrafted using tightly rolled 100% recycled paper, replacing traditional wood and helping reduce deforestation. The seed capsule at the end contains assorted seed varieties like basil, tomato, marigold, spinach, chilly, or mustard—making the planting process exciting and educational. Once the becomes too small to use, simply plant the stub in soil, water regularly, and observe your seeds grow. Clear and simple instructions are included with every set to guide first-time users and children.

The thoughtfully designed recycled paper tube packaging protects the and enhances presentation, making them ideal for gifting. Lightweight, compact, and travel-friendly, this packaging ensures your 12 pencils stay organized while reflecting your brand’s eco-conscious values. Whether you’re buying in bulk for events or purchasing single sets, this sustainable stationery alternative promotes an impactful green message.

Why Choose?

Switching to the Plantable Seed Pencil (12pc set) helps reduce carbon footprint, minimize waste, promote eco-awareness, and support recycling. These are safe for kids, biodegradable, non-toxic, and crafted using premium materials. They offer the perfect blend of sustainability, functionality, and aesthetic appeal. Ideal for schools, colleges, corporates, artists, and eco-conscious buyers, these pencils offer a greener alternative to wooden while encouraging tree-growing habits.

Key Features

  • Set of 12 pencils made from 100% recycled paper
  • Premium-quality 2B graphite rods for smooth and dark writing
  • Assorted seed varieties for planting after use
  • Sustainable and eco-friendly alternative to wood pencils
  • Comes in recycled paper tube packaging for safe storage and gifting
  • Instructions included for easy planting
  • Perfect for corporate gifting, school kits, workshops, and environmental campaigns
  • Biodegradable, non-toxic, and child-safe materials

Who Can Use?

The is suitable for students, teachers, artists, professionals, and eco-conscious consumers. Corporates use them for branding, students use them for writing and drawing, and NGOs distribute them for awareness programs. Their eco-friendly nature also makes them ideal as return gifts for birthdays, festivals, exhibitions, and eco-theme events.

Grow Your Green Companion

With each pencil offering a chance to grow a plant, the assorted seed varieties help promote gardening and sustainability habits. The packaging has clear instructions included, making it easy for children and adults to use. Whether you choose them for personal use or gifting, these combine creativity, purpose, and environmental impact.
